title: sales-partnership-scratch-notes-ishaan-mehta
content:
Account: QuantumCloud (mid-market cloud infra marketplace)
Notes:
- HQ: SF; ~450 employees; raised Series B 2024.
- Primary product: multi-cloud deployment + cost optimization for infra teams.
- Tech stack: Kubernetes, Terraform / Pulumi, custom orchestration layer.
- Likely pain: high per-token / inference cost for dev tools, needing predictable latency for customer-facing assistants (SRE runbooks, cost insights).
- Potential fit with Redwood: Dedicated pools for predictable throughput + private deploy for regulated customers; Optimize to reduce inference unit cost; Console for per-route/agent observability.
- Champion persona: Head of Platform / Director of Developer Tools (probable names: Maria Lopez - Sr. Dir Platform; Eng Mgr: Ben Chu).
- Procurement: procurement + legal for enterprise (typical 6–9 week cycle).

Account research quick wins:
- Reference open-source infra they contribute to (check GitHub org) -> mention in outreach.
- Call out use-case: internal knowledge assistant for runbooks and cost alerts -> propose low-lift POC using hosted API then transition to Dedicated.
- Highlight performance numbers: show token latency and cost reductions via batching/quantization on similar customers (quantified examples).

Outbound cold email (short):
Subject: Reduce inference spend for QuantumCloud dev tools by 30%
Hi Maria,
Saw QuantumCloud’s new cost-optimizer feature — congrats on the rollout. We help infra teams cut inference unit costs while keeping latency predictable (Dedicated + Optimize). Can I share a 15–20 min plan showing a POC with existing models and expected savings?
— Ishaan

Outbound cold email (longer / sales sequence step 1):
Subject: POC idea: cut assistant token costs while keeping sub-200ms p95 latency
Hi Maria,
I’m Ishaan on the partnerships team at Redwood Inference — we help platform teams run LLMs at scale with predictable latency and lower unit costs. For teams like QuantumCloud who expose assistant-like features to customers, two common blockers we solve: 1) unexpected token spend from high-frequency requests, 2) latency spikes during scale.
If you’re open, I can put together a 2-week POC plan: hosted API to validate quality + migration path to Dedicated (cost model + infra checklist). Low commitment — we use a small eval set from you.
Would Tuesday or Thursday next week work for a quick call?

Phone/VM script:
- Quick intro: Ishaan, Redwood Inference (15–20s)
- One-liner value: predictable latency + 20–40% lower unit cost for typical infra-assistant workloads.
- Ask: who owns the embedded assistant / internal dev tools? quick qualification.
- Close: propose 15 min to review a POC plan and share prior case study.

Objection handling (common):
Objection: "We already use OpenAI / vendor X — migration is risky."
Rebuttal: "Totally get it. We start with a hosted API POC so you only evaluate quality & latency. If it looks good, we provide a migration path that supports model parity and fallbacks; customers keep vendor access during rollout. We also provide quantization suggestions that reduce infra cost without quality regressions."

Objection: "We can't justify the ops overhead / dedicated infra."
Rebuttal: "We offer a staged approach: validate on hosted, then Dedicated only if throughput/SLAs require it. Our Console + managed autoscaling reduces ops lift compared to fully self-hosted solutions — and we provide runbooks + onboarding support."

Objection: "Pricing is unclear / we're concerned about cost predictability."
Rebuttal: "We run a short spend model run with your traffic profile and show expected token/unit costs under different batch/caching profiles — customers typically see clear inflection points where dedicated capacity pays off. We can share a sample modelling doc."

Case study snippets to use:
- "InfraTools": migrated their dev assistant POC -> Dedicated, reduced per-token cost by ~32% while maintaining p95 latency <200ms. (Quant: 32% cost reduction, 3-week migration, no user-facing regressions)
- "FinData Co.": private deployment for regulated customers; used caching + quantization to cut inference spend for historical queries by 45%.

Ask / next steps checklist:
- Get sample eval set: 200 representative prompts + traffic distribution (peak/minute, typical request size)
- Intro call with Eng/Platform owner + SRE (15m)
- Run 2-week hosted POC metric baseline (latency, cost per token, error rate)
- If viable -> Dedicated sizing proposal + rough cost model

To-dos (personal):
- Pull QuantumCloud GitHub org + look for references to OSS projects they maintain (due 2026-02-24)
- Connect w/ Lena to get InfraTools case study deck (ask for numbers/slide)
- Draft one-pager POC timeline template for partnerships (template v0)
- Find recent competitor win notes (OpenAI + Anthropic integrations) to prep objection handling doc

Random notes / snippets to keep handy:
- Use phrase: "predictable latency SLOs" instead of "lower latency" for platform owners.
- Call out "per-route dashboards" as a security/observability win for platform teams.
- Bring up KMS/HSM support early for security-conscious accounts.

Last outreach sent: 2026-02-25 (short intro to Maria via LinkedIn). No reply yet. Plan: sequence step 2 follow-up email on 2026-03-03 with one-pager attached.

-- end of scratch notes --
